geo_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]          
  if (length(x) == 0) {  
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  exp(mean(log(x)))
}

    Q3 = exp(quantile(log(elisa), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

geo_summary <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]  
  if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(y = NA, ymin = NA, ymax = NA))
  
  logx <- log(x)
  data.frame(
    y    = exp(mean(logx)),                         # geometric mean
    ymin = exp(quantile(logx, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), # Q1
    ymax = exp(quantile(logx, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))  # Q3
  )
}

# Run Wilcoxon test for each timepoint
stat.test <- df.alum %>%
  drop_na(elisa, age_group, subject) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  wilcox_test(elisa ~ age_group) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint", dodge = 0.8)
stat.test <- stat.test %>% filter(!p.adj.signif == "ns")
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  mutate(y.position = c(2.8, 3, 3, 3, 2.7)[seq_len(n())])  # example

# Now plot

  geom_line(aes(group = subject, color = age_group), size = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FFAE4D","#AA87E8"), guide = "none") + 
  new_scale_color() +
  
  stat_summary(fun.data = geo_summary,
               geom = "line",
               aes(color = age_group, group = age_group),
               size = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = geo_summary,
               geom = "point",
               shape = 21,
               aes(fill = age_group, group = age_group),
               color = "black",
               size = 2) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E66100","#5D3A9B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E66100","#5D3A9B")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number()) +
  ct2 +
  theme(strip.text = element_blank()) +
  
  # Add p-value significance annotations
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, 
                     label = "p.adj.signif",  # shows *, **, ***
                     tip.length = 0.01,
                     hide.ns = TRUE)

#geo mean with 95% CI
geo_mean_CI <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]  # drop non-positive values
  if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(y = NA, ymin = NA, ymax = NA))
  
  logx <- log(x)
  n <- length(logx)
  mean_log <- mean(logx)
  se_log <- sd(logx) / sqrt(n)
  
  # 95% CI on log scale
  CI_lower <- mean_log - 1.96 * se_log
  CI_upper <- mean_log + 1.96 * se_log
  
  data.frame(
    y = exp(mean_log),       # geometric mean
    ymin = exp(CI_lower),    # lower CI
    ymax = exp(CI_upper)     # upper CI
  )
}

#geo mean with 95% CI
geo_mean_CI <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]  # drop non-positive values
  if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(y = NA, ymin = NA, ymax = NA))
  
  logx <- log(x)
  n <- length(logx)
  mean_log <- mean(logx)
  se_log <- sd(logx) / sqrt(n)
  
  # 95% CI on log scale
  CI_lower <- mean_log - 1.96 * se_log
  CI_upper <- mean_log + 1.96 * se_log
  
  data.frame(
    y = exp(mean_log),       # geometric mean
    ymin = exp(CI_lower),    # lower CI
    ymax = exp(CI_upper)     # upper CI
  )
}
